title: Baseten Launches RL Environment Network for Model Post-Training
summary:
The AI infrastructure provider created a consortium of reinforcement learning (RL) firms to assist its users in building specialized settings for model post-training. Members of the new Baseten Environment Network work directly with customers to develop these environments based on specific tasks and data, while Baseten manages the training and production deployment.

Baseten said the network is designed to expand its applied research capacity and provide customers with vetted partners to build specialized intelligence at scale. The company stated that RL environments are the primary way models continue to learn in real-world applications.

Today we’re announcing the Baseten Environment Network, a group of the best RL environment companies that will help our customers build custom environments for post-training.

The Network extends our applied research capacity, helping more customers build environments around their own tasks, data, and feedback.

Partners work directly with customers to create the environments, while we continue to handle model training and production deployment.
